text:
Maria: Quick poll — what's your go-to commute soundtrack? Vote with emoji: :headphones: for lofi/jazz, :guitar: for rock/indie, :microphone: for podcasts, :ghost: for true crime. Drop a quick rec if you want.

Jake: :headphones: Definitely lofi. Saves my brain from train announcements. Rec: 'Lofty Mornings' playlist on Spotify.

Sam: :microphone: Podcasts here. I use the commute for listening — '99% Invisible' or 'The Daily' depending on mood.

Olivia: :guitar: Indie/alt. Morning riff to wake up. Current go-to: Snail Mail + Peach Pit. :sunglasses:

Nina: :ghost: True crime for peak attention. Rec: 'Casefile'. Also yes to being slightly unnerved getting off the subway.

Maria: Nice spread. Quick tally so far: lofi 1, podcasts 1, indie 1, true crime 1. Anyone else want to chime in or are we a perfect tie? :bar_chart:

deploy-bot: Heads-up: all-hands deploy at 3pm today — unrelated but important :rocket:

Jake: Tie-breaker suggestion: whoever adds a one-song rec breaks the tie. I'll add a 2-min lofi instrumental link: https://open.spotify.com/track/example (non-affiliate)

Olivia: Adding 'The Less I Know The Better' for indie points. Also happy to have a mixed playlist.

Sam: Ok tie resolved — collate everyone's recs into one 'Commute Collage' playlist? Friday commute special? :musical_note:

Nina: Love that. Also gentle request: no true crime spoilers before 10am meetings. :pleading_face:

Maria: Agreed on the spoiler policy. I'll make the Collage and drop the link in #random-polls tomorrow. Thanks for the quick votes! :headphones: :guitar: :microphone: :ghost:
